name: Endocrine disruptors
aliases: Endocrine disruptors, EDCs, endocrine disrupting chemicals, hormonal disruptors
what_is: Substances that interfere with the hormonal system. They can mimic, block or alter natural hormones, affecting how the body functions.
why_botia: Interacting with hormones is not automatically harmful. Endocrine disruption must be shown for each substance; real-world risk also depends on exposure. The evidence does not support calling all women more vulnerable or blaming the whole class for PCOS, endometriosis, infertility or hormone-sensitive cancers.
can_1: Provide contextual information on endocrine disruption risk from food contact materials and environmental exposure.
can_2: Connect this risk to specific ingredients flagged on the label when applicable.
cannot_1: Measure the level of endocrine disruptors in a specific product from the label alone.
cannot_2: Assess your personal cumulative exposure or individual hormonal sensitivity.

sources.label: WHO/UNEP State of the Science of Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals (2012)
